title: Inequalities in use of and exposure to artificial intelligence
discussion_signal: The post highlights a large gap in AI use between high- and low-income countries and connects usage, connectivity, and exposure to uneven development prospects. It makes digital access a distributional infrastructure question rather than a simple adoption metric.
linked_research_question: How do income, connectivity, and digital capability shape who can use AI and who bears its exposure without its benefits?
limits: Professional summary of a World Bank data story
The post does not provide the full methodology
LinkedIn engagement is not a representative global sample
